valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: a compound growth rate of earnings is not defined from the periods on file: it needs net profit POSITIVE in BOTH endpoint years (FY2022 and FY2026), and one of them is not. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the total-equity row the P/B divides is an order of magnitude from its own adjacent year (FY2024 4.39e+06 against FY2023 1.20579e+08), so the book value for FY2026 is not verified. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
